findings.chapter: Review scope / input limitation (not a book defect)
findings.evidence: PDF page 177/553 excerpt ends: "The memory floor is the first constraint every architecture decision respects, because unlike compute or bandwidth it cannot be moved by better kernels or scheduling — it is set by the model’s". The supplied material then states: "[Truncated beyond 200 pages]". Document metadata also states: "PDF Document: book.pdf | Total Pages: 553 | Rendered Page Images Attached: 4", while the instruction says "519 pages".
findings.issue: The complete document was not available for review. Only four rendered page images and extractable text through PDF page 177/553 were provided; pages 178 onward were inaccessible. Therefore the mandated full-coverage, cross-reference, cross-chapter consistency, arithmetic, evidence-label, recurrence, and figure/caption passes cannot be truthfully completed. No book defects are filed because filing unverified findings would violate the anti-fabrication requirement.
